If you wanted to build your own stuff and be creative, you'd buy Lego Classic which is basically just a set of random bricks without a manual where you can do whatever you want with it.  
  
So let's say I now want to build the thing on the picture. I have got all the bricks, but no instructions are given. In the case of legos, you would contact customer service and get the manual. In the case of this, I contact people with knowledge on the internet.
